issuing_body: Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI), Japan
covered_actors: public institutions such as governments and municipalities
prohibited_practices: Do not develop, provide, or use AI systems and services with purpose of manipulating human decision making, recognition and emotion or on the premise of unconscious control
enforcement_authorities: Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications
implementation_notes: The Guidelines are voluntary and intended as a reference for business operators. They follow an agile governance/living document approach and are to be updated as needed. Generative AI is explicitly included in scope. Non-business users and data providers are excluded from the target audience.
